narrative.overview: Dala's surface is a cinematic, near-monochrome landing rendered almost entirely in pure black. The single load-bearing visual is a generative particle cloud that literalises 'Unlock collective wisdom.' as scattered knowledge coalescing. Oversized editorial typography floats on black; one electric purple does all the accent work. This shared base tightens the captured surface where it was loose — 120px sections reduced to 64px, ad-hoc scale replaced by a modular scale, the 200/400/600 weight range exercised — while pinning palette and typeface to the captured brand.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-black canvas (#000000) as the dominant material.
One restrained accent (electric purple #8052ff), used on conversion only.
A single private typeface (PP Neue Montreal) carrying display, body and UI.
Generative / abstract imagery over literal product screenshots.
Long-scroll, manifesto-paced narrative; balanced (not airy) density.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Electric purple appears on conversion affordances only; under 10% of any viewport. Its scarcity makes 'Request Access' read as the one thing to do.

rules.name: The Modular-Scale Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built on a fixed modular ratio (≥1.25), never on ad-hoc size jumps. The captured uneven ratios are retired.

rules.name: The Weight-and-Scale Rule
rules.body: Light 200 carries atmospheric lead-ins; SemiBold 600 carries structural heads. Contrast comes from weight and scale together.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift off the black. No card vocabulary, no elevation ramp; separate with space, not shadows.

dos: Do build on pure black (#000000) and treat blackspace as the primary material.
Do reserve electric purple (#8052ff) for conversion affordances only.
Do drive hierarchy through a strict modular scale and the 200/400/600 weight range together.
Do keep surfaces flat — separate with space, not shadows.
Do give links descriptive text and sections numbered eyebrows.
donts: Don't introduce a generic SaaS blue gradient hero or a 3-up feature-card grid.
Don't add stock illustration, light dashboards, or dense multi-card layouts.
Don't spread purple into decoration, dividers, or backgrounds.
Don't lead with feature bullet lists.
Don't add drop shadows or a card elevation ramp.
Don't smuggle in editorial-register costume vocabulary.
